delay tip dbdc:
Average the last <Delay Statistics> delay samples per online link (select 0 to disable the delay rule).
When to filter:
	1. Among balancing online links, some means are below and some above <Delay Boundary(ms)>; otherwise do not filter, all stay in balancing
Who joins balancing:
	1. Links whose mean is below the boundary
	2. Links whose mean is above the boundary, but exceeds the best mean by no more than <Delay Difference(ms)>
	(Others may stay online, but are not used for load sharing)
delay tip hot:
Average the last <Delay Statistics> delay samples per online link (select 0 to disable delay switching; then prefer smallest slot number only).
When to switch:
	1. Current link offline: switch now
	2. Some online link is below <Delay Boundary(ms)> and current is not the smallest-numbered among them: switch (hot failback)
	Note: When every link's mean is above <Delay Boundary(ms)> and the current link is online, do not switch
Switch target:
	1. Prefer: smallest-numbered online link below the boundary
	2. Otherwise (picking after offline when none are below): lowest-mean online link
delay tip lazy:
Average the last <Delay Statistics> delay samples per online link (select 0 to disable delay switching; while current link stays up and delay is off, do not fail back by slot number).
When to switch:
	1. Current link offline: switch now
	2. Current link still up: all of the following
		- Some online link is below <Delay Boundary(ms)>
		- Current mean is above the boundary
		- Current exceeds the best mean by more than <Delay Difference(ms)>
Switch target:
	1. Lowest-mean online link
